device_analysis.device_type: Vertical racetrack resonator with dual internal segmented bus waveguides
device_analysis.how_it_works: The outer racetrack ring provides optical resonance. Two horizontal bus waveguides run through the center interior, each with 2 rectangular slot cutouts. Light couples between the bus waveguides and the ring at the curved sections.

topology.outer_ring: Vertical racetrack shape - two semicircular bends (top/bottom) connected by vertical straight sections
topology.inner_buses: Two horizontal waveguides inside the ring, vertically separated, each with 2 rectangular slots
topology.symmetry: Symmetric about both horizontal and vertical centerlines

function_defining_knobs: ring_width - width of the racetrack ring waveguide
ring_radius - bend radius of semicircular ends
straight_length - length of straight sections of racetrack
bus_width - width of internal bus waveguides
bus_length - horizontal extent of each bus
bus_vert_offset - vertical separation of buses from center
slot_width - width of rectangular slot cutouts
